facts.value: Genesee & Wyoming Inc. (G&W), through Pullman Acquisition Sub Inc.
Strategic: owner or lessee of 121 freight railroads worldwide.
$25.00 per common share in cash; each preferred share converts into 100 common shares before the merger. Termination fee $3.785m.
Met (process 1): 26 parties (11 strategic and 14 financial NDA signers from the March 2016 outreach, plus Party C)

facts.field: Currency and units of bid prices
facts.value: US dollars per common share, assuming conversion of preferred stock into common stock
Greene Holcomb & Fisher LLC (GHF), whose business BMO Capital Markets Corp. acquired on 08/01/2016; BMO gave the fairness opinion
Hinckley, Allen & Snyder LLP; unnamed STB counsel

After Party A, a Class I rail partner, showed interest in an equity stake in late 2015, PWRR hired GHF and in March 2016 decided to explore a sale. GHF contacted 29 potential buyers, 25 of which signed confidentiality agreements, and nine submitted IOIs of $17.93–$26.50. Seven advanced, and late entrant Party C joined them; six submitted LOIs in late July, led by Party B at $24.00. PWRR moved to confirmatory diligence and negotiation with Party B and G&W, rebuffed revised bids from Parties D and E, and prioritized Party B. On 08/12/2016 G&W raised its offer to $25.00 in cash, Party B would not raise its $24.00, and PWRR signed with G&W that day.
